Chat completion via Azure OpenAI with the azure/ prefix for provider routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$request = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["maxTokens" => 16, "messages" => [["content" => "Say hello", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "azure/gpt-4", "temperature" => 0]));
$result = LiterLlm::chat($request);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->getMessage()->getContent());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
var_dump($result->model);
var_dump($result->getUsage()?->totalTokens);
```
